notes: Pilot 3 (cascaded/WebRTC): LiveKit transport -> Pipecat -> Deepgram STT -> OpenAI LLM (gpt-4o-mini class) -> Cartesia TTS. Profile cascaded_full: each leg is separately observable (Deepgram speech_final/is_final, OpenAI first SSE chunk, Cartesia first chunk, Pipecat frames + LiveKit metrics), so per-provider pack attribution is legitimate here. Moved off PSTN in the budget program: pilots 1 vs 3 isolate architecture (S2S vs cascaded) with transport held constant — cleaner attribution, no telephony bill. Expected spend near $0: Deepgram signup credits (~$200) cover STT, Cartesia free tier covers TTS, OpenAI mini-class model is pennies for ~120 turns. p99 labeled directional until topped up. Provenance is produced by the adapter at run time into provenance.json. Adapter contract: evals/measure/adapters/README.md.
